objective: Test whether the exact-rank quadratic interaction subspace can be generated by a geometry-derived descriptor of component pairs, especially local capacity and residual release timing, rather than arbitrary canonical component IDs.
descriptor_ladder: CAP6: component width + remaining local capacity modulo 6
CAP_EXACT: component width + exact remaining local capacity
DELAY: ARITY + per-owner residual release-depth histograms relative to current frontier
HEIGHT_DELAY: DELAY + sorted local column-height multiset
EXACT: full canonical component type control
pair_rule: For each T2-O state and exact rank, replace each unordered odd-component pair by the unordered pair of frozen descriptors; duplicate descriptor-pair occurrences cancel mod 2.
anti_circularity: Descriptor definitions use only current-rank geometry, RFG residuals, and gravity timing.
W/D/L outcomes do not define, select, or refine descriptor modes.
Exact affine/linear component identities remain unchanged so this experiment isolates only the quadratic interaction coordinate.
The EXACT mode must reproduce the previously established full degree-2 structural rank and exact decoder.
targets: structural rank gain over degree one
whether the full EW-RS-034 quadratic interaction span is preserved
compression relative to the exact pair catalog
falsifiers: If EXACT fails to reproduce the established degree-2 rank or exact decoder, the experiment is mechanically invalid.
If a coarse descriptor loses full structural rank, it is not a complete generator of the observed interaction subspace.
If a coarse descriptor produces scalar contradictions, it is not sufficient for Q-V on that carrier.
next_if_success: Freeze the smallest geometry-derived descriptor that survives all three carriers, then qualify it on a fresh holdout before attempting a closed-form pair coefficient law.
next_if_fail: Use the first structural rank deficit to add one independently motivated timing coordinate at a time; do not fit descriptor refinements from outcome labels.
